consent.page.title: Privacy preferences
consent.page.summary: Choose how Joprelys Connect may remember your preferences. Mechanisms required for security and authentication always remain active.
consent.page.noBanner: No advertising tracker or optional audience measurement tool is currently active. Joprelys therefore does not display an intrusive consent banner.
consent.category.necessary.title: Strictly necessary
consent.category.necessary.description: Authentication, session security, token rotation and mechanisms required for the service to operate.
consent.category.preferences.title: Interface preferences
consent.category.preferences.description: Remembers your language, light or dark theme and selected display preferences on this device.
consent.category.analytics.title: Audience measurement
consent.category.analytics.description: Tools used to understand general service usage. No tool in this category is currently integrated.
consent.category.marketing.title: Marketing and advertising
consent.category.marketing.description: Advertising trackers, commercial profiling or targeting. Joprelys Connect currently uses no tool in this category.
consent.actions.saved: Your privacy preferences have been saved.
consent.actions.rejected: Optional preference storage has been disabled and removed from this device.
consent.page.securityNote: The session refresh cookie remains strictly necessary and is protected with HttpOnly, Secure in production and SameSite attributes. It cannot be disabled from this page without preventing normal authentication operation.
consent.page.futureNote: Any future analytics or marketing tool will remain disabled by default and will require explicit activation before loading whenever consent is required.
